summary: Cadeler A/S filed a 6-K reminder that Oslo Børs trading in its DKK 1.00 shares (ISIN DK0061412772) is suspended from 5 November 2026 until delisting, and that NYSE trading of its ADSs (four shares each) is expected to halt pre-open the same day with delisting ten days later, alongside termination of the ADR programme. This follows its 21 September 2026 voluntary exchange offer by UK-incorporated Cadeler plc (one USD 1.00 share per share) tied to the group's Denmark-to-UK redomiciliation; a Danish Companies Act squeeze-out notice on/about 9 November 2026 sets a four-week cash transfer period. Watch squeeze-out pricing, EGM delisting approval and residual-holder risk.
